# Earthmatic

> Earthmatic measures energy and carbon in industrial operations across South Asia, then builds the systems that keep those numbers accurate year after year. Audit-grade methodology, delivered by engineers who have been on the factory floor.

## Docs

- [Home](/): Overview of Earthmatic's carbon accounting, energy audit and carbon project services for industrial operations in South Asia.
- [Services](/services): The five services Earthmatic provides and the six-step process (Scope, Measure, Model, Reduce, Verify, Maintain) used on every engagement.
- [Platform](/platform): The Earthmatic software platform for holding emissions data, energy meters and evidence trails, currently in development with early clients.
- [Work](/work): Case studies with measured results from carbon accounting, energy audit and carbon project engagements.
- [Insights](/insights): Regulation explainers, technical notes and market notes on carbon accounting, energy audits and South Asian industrial decarbonisation.
- [About](/about): Earthmatic's origin, working principles, team and where the firm operates.
- [Contact](/contact): How to book an assessment, send a general enquiry, or reach Earthmatic directly.
